notes: No scribe, commissioner, owner or king is named. The only person is Śrīdharasvāmin, author of the Bhagavadgītāṭīkā (Subodhinī), listed as commentator for filtering. The Newari phrase 'kunhu(?) gītāsaṃpūrṇṇayāṇāvacopāditaḥ' is garbled (kunhu = 'on the day'; saṃpūrṇa yāṇā = 'having completed'; the rest, perhaps intended as something like '-copāditaḥ/sampāditaḥ', is unreadable) and contains no personal name. Era taken as NS since the three-digit saṃvat year with a Newari context fits Nepal Saṃvat; 880 NS = c. 1760 CE. Catalogue fields are empty, so no conflicts.
